close_input_recheck.result: satisfactory finite ownership boundary by code inspection
checks: hide_codex invalidates view/detail generations and cancels pending touch adapters.
App clears displayed quotes and profile context when closing.
Current close event is consumed with set_input_as_handled before GUI focus release; it cannot fall through this same mouse-up to the shoot adapter.
Router queue is cleared and tree resumes immediately, while Home input adapters remain blocked.
After exactly the next process_frame, input only restores if still HOME, captured Home is alive and still current, codex remains closed, and no other menu is open.
Reopening codex/another menu or replacing/removing Home during the wait cannot revive old adapters.
Application focus loss closes the codex through the same path; InputRouter independently rejects unfocused actions.
_open_home_function and _open_home_navigation refuse competing Home panels while codex is open.
close_input_recheck.profile_switch_modal: A profile-context mismatch rejects submit while keeping the blocking modal until a real close; it does not silently resume gameplay or redirect an old intent into the new owner.
